## Recruitment Models Built for Your Hiring Goals




Whether you need a single executive or an entire team, recruit3 delivers flexible engagement models that adapt to your timeline, budget, and culture. Explore our four core service offerings below.

How We Work

## A proven hiring process built on transparency and speed.


We know that hiring managers need predictability. Our four-step methodology removes guesswork, aligns with your timelines, and delivers qualified candidates who fit your culture — every time.


Learn More About Our Process






- 01 ### Discover Deep-dive intake to map your exact requirements, team culture, and growth goals.

- 02 ### Source Multi-channel talent search tapping passive networks and our vetted candidate pool.

- 03 ### Evaluate Rigorous skills assessment, behavioral interviews, and culture-fit validation.

- 04 ### Deliver Shortlist presentation, interview coordination, and offer management to close.

client satisfaction score

- Skills-based assessments & testing

Our Mission & Values


## Transparent, results-driven recruitment that builds your team


At Recruit3, we believe great companies are built by great people. Our mission is to transform the hiring experience through radical transparency, data-driven matching, and a genuine commitment to long-term partnerships. We don't just fill roles — we fuel growth.


As one of the most trusted temporary staffing agencies in the industry, we combine deep market expertise with a human-first approach. Every search is backed by real-time analytics, rigorous vetting, and a promise: if we wouldn't hire them for our own team, we won't send them to yours.

Partner with us










Our Story

## How recruit3 was founded


We set out to solve slow, opaque hiring with a structured, transparent approach that puts people first.




- 2019 ### The problem becomes clear After years in HR leadership, our founders saw the same pattern everywhere: hiring teams drowning in resumes, candidates lost in black holes, and critical roles staying vacant for months. The industry was built on speed over quality, and nobody was measuring what actually mattered — retention, culture fit, and long-term performance.

- 2020 ### Building the blueprint We spent a year designing a recruitment methodology that combined structured interviewing, skills-based assessments, and transparent reporting dashboards. Every step was documented, every metric was tracked. We partnered with three early-adopter companies to pressure-test the model across tech, healthcare, and professional services hiring.

- 2021 ### recruit3 launches We opened our doors with a clear mission: make hiring measurable. Our structured process reduced time-to-hire by 40% for our first ten clients while improving candidate quality scores. Word spread quickly among HR directors who were tired of the traditional agency model and wanted a true talent partner.

- 2022 ### Scaling with integrity Our team grew to 25 recruitment specialists, each trained in our proprietary evaluation framework. We expanded into temporary staffing services and executive search, always maintaining the same level of rigor and transparency. Client retention hit 94%, and our placement success rate climbed above 92%.

- 2024 ### Shaping the future of work Today, recruit3 partners with over 150 organizations across North America, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. We continue to invest in data-driven hiring tools, diversity sourcing strategies, and the belief that every great company is built one great hire at a time.

Support


## Frequently asked questions


Clear answers for hiring managers evaluating recruitment partnerships. If you don't see your question, reach out to our team directly.






**Q: How long does the typical placement take?**




Most roles are filled within 2–4 weeks for professional positions and 48–72 hours for temporary staffing needs. Timelines vary by industry, seniority, and market conditions, but our proactive talent pools and pre-vetted candidate networks consistently deliver faster results than industry averages.










**Q: What industries do you serve?**




We partner with organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, logistics, and professional services. Our specialized recruiters understand the nuances of each sector, from hard-to-find engineering talent to compliance-heavy healthcare staffing. Whether you need one critical hire or a full project team, our industry-aligned approach ensures cultural and technical fit.










**Q: How is your pricing structured?**




We offer transparent, success-based pricing models: contingency search (pay only upon successful placement), retained search for executive roles, and contract/temporary staffing with straightforward hourly or daily rates. There are no hidden fees — you'll receive a clear proposal tailored to your hiring volume and role complexity before we begin.










**Q: What makes recruit3 different from other temporary staffing agencies?**




Unlike traditional temporary staffing services, we combine data-driven candidate matching with a dedicated account team that learns your culture, not just your job descriptions. Our average client stays with us for 3+ years because we prioritize retention and quality over volume. Every candidate is interviewed, reference-checked, and skills-assessed before submission — saving your hiring managers hours of screening time.










**Q: Do you offer temporary-to-permanent hiring?**




Yes. Our temp-to-perm model is one of our most popular solutions. You can evaluate a candidate's performance and cultural fit on the job before making a permanent offer. This approach significantly reduces mis-hire risk — over 85% of our temp-to-perm placements convert to full-time employees within six months.










**Q: What geographic regions do you cover?**




We operate across North America and Europe, with dedicated regional teams who understand local talent markets, employment regulations, and salary benchmarks. Whether you're hiring for a single office or multiple locations, our coordinated approach ensures consistent quality and compliance across borders.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/21/2026



recruit3 ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: recruit3

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 21, 2026



recruit3 is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: recruit3

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

recruit3 provides Recruitment & Staffing through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.
